text: Escalation: Dana Whitfield (Globex IT) emailed this morning. Globex *cannot roll Atlas out to their 120 robots without SSO*, and she was clear the *$480k renewal on Nov 30* is at risk if SSO slips past October.
This is our top account issue. What do they need from us right now?
A written SSO timeline they can take to their CIO, plus a named contact for the KeyGate dependency.
I'll send Dana the written timeline. Devon, can you give me dates I can stand behind?
Best current: KeyGate fix Oct 9, our verification 2 days, SSO enabled for Globex by Oct 14. I'd caveat the KeyGate part.
Happy to get on a call with Dana's CIO if it helps. Keep me posted.
